facets.description: Lines 9-11: execute(...)[0]['id'] for the embed_category lookup has no empty-result check, so it raises NoMethodError when no row or matching category exists
Line 15: execute(...)[0]['value'] for the uncategorized_category_id fallback has no empty-result check, so it crashes if the row is missing
Line 25: the host value is interpolated into the INSERT without escaping, so a quote or a blank line breaks the statement
